they'll have to shell out a solid 80-90 lpa to pull you from salesforce.

you're not just another full stack dev; you're defining strategy for multiple teams and getting to play with genai.

it's a proper leadership role, not just a title, and a chance to get into ai before it gets boring.

Full Stack Staff Engineer (React & Java) at Equinix

equinix is hiring a full stack staff engineer in bengaluru.

they'll have to pay up to get you from salesforce, so i'm guessing 70-85 lpa is doable.

you're not just building another app, you're writing the code that runs the physical internet inside their data centers.

it's a move from salesforce's crm world to the core infrastructure that powers it – a proper engineering flex.
